sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Reservations"."Room" AS e, AVG("Reservations"."Rate") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Reservations"."Kids" - "Reservations"."Adults") AS REAL) / "Reservations"."Adults")) AS m2 FROM "Reservations" GROUP BY "Reservations"."Room"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Reservations.relative difference of number of children from number of adults
why: average of nightly rate charged per Rooms (by Room)
(number of children - number of adults) / number of adults: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of number of children from number of adults per Rooms (by Room)
